name: 31648-multiturn-qwen35-4b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B. Ungated, 8.7 GiB of bf16 safetensors in two shards, no remote code.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 6144 requests with a 3600 s safety cap. One stream carries one twelve-turn conversation, so 64 streams is 64 conversations in flight and 6144 requests is 512 conversations.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, twelve turns of 512 prompt / 32 output tokens, fixed lengths, no spread, no shared prefix. The client replays the whole (user, assistant) history every turn, so the prompt the server sees grows 512 -> ~6.5k over a conversation and averages ~3.5k. `temperature` 0 and `ignore_eos` are pinned through `backend.extras.body`, so 32 output tokens means exactly 32. Seed 42.
purpose: A twelve-turn chat assistant on a 4B model, 64 concurrent conversations with short replies, one GPU.
launch:
# sglang at the commit named by setupcard.md `commit_id`, so the interpreter is the one named by
# configs/env.yaml `venv:`. Everything not listed here is a stock default of that commit.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B

tp-size: 1

# 384 recurrent-state slots. The engine caps concurrency at `max_mamba_cache_size // 5`, i.e. 76
# here, above the 64 declared streams; 320 would cap at exactly 64 and 256 at 51.
max-mamba-cache-size: 384

# If the server will not start, this is the one lever -- downward, in steps.
mem-fraction-static: 0.82

# The deepest turn reaches ~6.6 k tokens; the checkpoint's own 262144 would size the
# request-to-token pool for a context this workload never approaches.
context-length: 10240

random-seed: 42
